answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent earns full rewards only by trading with many independent peers, like a meadow of many streams. A new identity must do paid work with 20 established agents before earnings unlock. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 partners, each paying fees plus 10 epochs, so total cost is 1,000 x 15 POA, one honest agent pays 15 POA once. A closed cluster spirals down, its rate halving each epoch till it bridges out.
